title: Great app, but sluggish
body: I always loved using this app to stay productive, and the syncing across multiple devices and ecosystems makes it pretty convenient. The app has recently become very sluggish, and the sync appears to be slowing things down. Scrolling in lists with many reminders seems to cause the app to experience some jitter - looks like a lazy-load of items on a list. It would be great to have the app more snappy and responsive, especially when adding items to your list on the go. I often use the app to set reminders, and it would be great if you could add reminders from within the iOS widget, as opposed to opening the entire app, waiting a bit, and then creating the reminder. Love the app, but it needs some optimisations to make it more responsive… sync tasks can happen silently in the background and should not affect foreground usage.

title: Easy to use, with essentials functions
body: I don’t know what I would do without this app. It’s easy to use and it has all the essential functions. Groups, sub-groups, repeat, etc. I plan my days, weeks, months, term and year with it. I plan for work and leisure. This app helps me keep track of it all. The design is sleek and not supercharged, no distraction. There’re many organiser apps out there. I’ve tried and discarded many. This one stays.
